calculation.expression: -(close_t / close_{t-3} - 1) when cross_asset_abs_deviation_dispersion_t > rolling_median_60d(dispersion_t); otherwise 0, then cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Contrarian three-session return signal activated only when cross-asset daily return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-session median.

validation.regime_notes: Daily ICIR remained positive across 2020-22 (0.1645), 2023-24 (0.1216), 2025-26 (0.1255), and 2026-07 onward (0.0996). 5-day ICIR 0.0803 is below gate; admission uses daily horizon. Small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
